summary.score_scope: Provisional score for measured technical SEO, on-page and schema only; not a full SEO health score.
top_findings: Unknown public URLs and unimplemented well-known endpoints return HTTP 500 instead of 404.
Disallowed CMS routes return HTTP 200 generic shells without crawler-visible noindex.
Production metadata, sitemap lastmod and SoftwareApplication offers differ from the current workspace source.
Production SoftwareApplication schema omits visible free and unlimited plans.
Public pages return private/no-store; CWV has not been measured.
quick_wins: Verify anonymous CMS route behavior and prevent indexation without relying only on robots.txt.
Deploy the intended source and recheck live sitemap, titles and Offer schema.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Seven sitemap URLs include EN/VI/x-default alternates.
Public marketing pages return 200 and are server-rendered.

findings.title: Unknown paths return 500
findings.description: Random missing paths and multiple unimplemented well-known paths returned HTTP 500 in production.
findings.recommendation: Route missing paths to a real 404 and validate at root and locale-prefixed paths.

findings.title: CMS routes are disallowed but lack noindex
findings.description: Five CMS paths returned 200 generic client shells without robots meta while robots.txt disallows them.
findings.recommendation: Enforce auth server-side and choose crawler-visible noindex or auth response; do not rely on robots alone.

findings.title: Sitemap production/source mismatch
findings.description: Production reports 2026-09-23 lastmod for all seven URLs, while workspace contains uncommitted per-route dates on 2026-10-28.
findings.recommendation: Confirm intended deployment and only publish accurate lastmod values.

findings.title: Public HTML is no-store
findings.description: Sampled public pages return Cache-Control private, no-cache, no-store; actual CWV impact is not measured.
findings.recommendation: Measure PSI/CrUX and TTFB before changing cache policy.

categories.name: On-page SEO
what_works: 14 main EN/VI URLs have unique titles, descriptions and H1s.
Hreflang alternates are reciprocal with x-default.

findings.title: Login hreflang points to noindex pages
findings.description: Login URLs are noindex,nofollow but still emit language alternates.
findings.recommendation: Consider omitting hreflang for login URLs.

findings.title: No movie detail page exists
findings.description: The site is hotel welcome-TV SaaS; gallery has six cards without individual public detail URLs.
findings.recommendation: Audit template detail metadata only if dedicated pages are introduced.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Live JSON-LD parses as valid JSON.
Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage and CollectionPage fit current site content.

findings.title: Production offers omit two real plans
findings.description: Production markup lists one unnamed $3/15,000 VND Offer while visible pricing and workspace schema contain free, 3-screen and unlimited plans.
findings.recommendation: Sync Offer names, price, currency and billing period with the localized pricing page.

findings.title: FAQ rich result is unlikely
findings.description: FAQ schema matches on-page content, but Google limits FAQ rich results regularly to authoritative government and health sites.
findings.recommendation: Keep markup for semantics only; do not forecast a FAQ SERP enhancement.

findings.title: Field and lab performance not measured
findings.description: No CrUX, PageSpeed, or Search Console credentials/data were available in this audit.
findings.recommendation: Run PSI and CrUX for phone/desktop and inspect TTFB after resolving deployment parity.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Wildcard robots policy allows general crawling.
Homepage primary content is visible in raw HTML.

findings.title: Agent discovery files absent
findings.description: llms.txt and ai-catalog.json return 404; markdown negotiation and AI-specific policy were not found.
findings.recommendation: Treat as optional; prioritize crawl/index and production parity first.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Make missing routes return 404 instead of 500.
Confirm and deploy intended SEO source version.

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Sync localized SoftwareApplication Offers with pricing page.
Replace permanent locale aliases using 307 with 308/301.
Measure CWV and TTFB before cache changes.

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Use Search Console index coverage and query/page data.
Review content depth and image accessibility/performance.

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Validate sitemap lastmod accuracy and canonicals after each release.

measurement_limits: No Search Console or GA4 data.
No backlink or SERP tracking data.
No dedicated movie/template detail pages exist in the current project.
